definition: Star and snowflake schemas organize analytical data around fact tables and dimensions, with snowflake schemas further normalizing dimension data into related tables.
entry_text: Star and snowflake schemas organize analytical data around fact tables and dimensions, with snowflake schemas further normalizing dimension data into related tables.
example: A warehouse designer keeps product category in one dimension for a star schema but separates it into a linked table in a snowflake schema.
label: Star and snowflake schemas
